title.sl: I want you to come, I used to · Kaj sledi glagolu
title.de: I want you to come, I used to · Was nach dem Verb kommt
title.it: I want you to come, I used to · Cosa segue il verbo
title.en: I want you to come, I used to · What follows the verb

description.sl: Za want: nekdo + to: I want you to come, ne *I want that you come*. Za enjoy -ing: enjoy walking, ne *enjoy to walk*. decide to; stop doing ali stop to do. In kar je bilo nekoč: I used to live in Leeds.
description.de: Nach want: jemand + to: I want you to come, nicht *I want that you come*. Nach enjoy -ing: enjoy walking, nicht *enjoy to walk*. decide to; stop doing oder stop to do. Und was früher so war: I used to live in Leeds.
description.it: Dopo want: qualcuno + to: I want you to come, non *I want that you come*. Dopo enjoy -ing: enjoy walking, non *enjoy to walk*. decide to; stop doing o stop to do. E ciò che era una volta: I used to live in Leeds.
description.en: After want: someone + to: I want you to come. After enjoy: -ing: enjoy walking. decide to; stop doing or stop to do. And what was so once: I used to live in Leeds.

story.sl: Auntie Edna used to live in Carlisle. Now she wants you to listen to the radio with her. · Auntie Edna je nekoč živela v Carlislu. Zdaj želi, da z njo poslušaš radio.
story.de: Auntie Edna used to live in Carlisle. Now she wants you to listen to the radio with her. · Auntie Edna hat früher in Carlisle gewohnt. Jetzt möchte sie, dass du mit ihr Radio hörst.
story.it: Auntie Edna used to live in Carlisle. Now she wants you to listen to the radio with her. · Auntie Edna una volta abitava a Carlisle. Ora vuole che tu ascolti la radio con lei.
story.en: Auntie Edna used to live in Carlisle. Now she wants you to listen to the radio with her.

instruction.sl: Pick the right form · Izberi pravilno obliko
instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form
instruction.it: Pick the right form · Scegli la forma giusta

exercises.prompt: I want ___ with me to Keswick, love.

explain.sl:
**want + nekdo + to, brez that**
- **I want you to come.** · Želim, da prideš.
- **She wants me to help.** · Želi, da ji pomagam.
explain.de:
**want + jemand + to, ohne that**
- **I want you to come.** · Ich will, dass du kommst.
- **She wants me to help.** · Sie will, dass ich helfe.
explain.it:
**want + qualcuno + to, senza that**
- **I want you to come.** · Voglio che tu venga.
- **She wants me to help.** · Vuole che io l'aiuti.
explain.en:
**want + someone + to, no that**
- **I want you to come.**
- **She wants me to help.**

instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form

explain.sl:
**Za enjoy, finish, mind, keep: -ing**
- **She enjoys knitting.** · Rada plete.
- **Do you mind waiting?** · Ti je vseeno, če počakaš?
explain.de:
**Nach enjoy, finish, mind, keep: -ing**
- **She enjoys knitting.** · Sie strickt gern.
- **Do you mind waiting?** · Macht es dir etwas aus zu warten?
explain.it:
**Dopo enjoy, finish, mind, keep: -ing**
- **She enjoys knitting.** · Le piace lavorare a maglia.
- **Do you mind waiting?** · Ti dispiace aspettare?
explain.en:
**After enjoy, finish, mind, keep: -ing**
- **She enjoys knitting.**
- **Do you mind waiting?**

instruction.sl: Pick the right form · Izberi pravilno obliko
instruction.de: Pick the right form · Wähle die richtige Form
instruction.it: Pick the right form · Scegli la forma giusta

exercises.prompt: Edna ___ live in Carlisle. Now she lives next door to Maggie.

explain.sl:
**Kar je bilo nekoč in ni več: used to + osnovna oblika, za vse osebe enako**
- **She used to live in Carlisle.** · Nekoč je živela v Carlislu.
explain.de:
**Was früher so war und nicht mehr ist: used to + Grundform, für jede Person gleich**
- **She used to live in Carlisle.** · Früher hat sie in Carlisle gewohnt.
explain.it:
**Ciò che era così e ora non è più: used to + forma base, uguale per tutte le persone**
- **She used to live in Carlisle.** · Una volta abitava a Carlisle.
explain.en:
**What was so and isn't now: used to + the base form, the same for every person**
- **She used to live in Carlisle.**

instruction.de: Which are right? · Welche sind richtig?
instruction.it: Which are right? · Quali sono giuste?

options: We decided to walk to the tarn.
We decided walking to the tarn.
Do you mind waiting a minute?
Mrs Hartley let us to go home early.

explain.sl:
**decide, hope, want → to; finish, mind, enjoy → -ing; let brez to**
- **I hope to see you soon.** · Upam, da se kmalu vidiva.
- **She let us go home.** · Pustila nas je domov.
explain.de:
**decide, hope, want → to; finish, mind, enjoy → -ing; let ohne to**
- **I hope to see you soon.** · Ich hoffe, dich bald zu sehen.
- **She let us go home.** · Sie hat uns nach Hause gehen lassen.
explain.it:
**decide, hope, want → to; finish, mind, enjoy → -ing; let senza to**
- **I hope to see you soon.** · Spero di vederti presto.
- **She let us go home.** · Ci ha lasciato andare a casa.
explain.en:
**decide, hope, want → to; finish, mind, enjoy → -ing; let takes no to**
- **I hope to see you soon.**
- **She let us go home.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Harry, nehaj govoriti in pojej večerjo!
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Harry, hör auf zu reden und iss dein Abendessen!
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Harry, smettila di parlare e mangia la cena!
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Harry, stop talking and eat your dinner!

exercises.text: Harry, stop ___ (talk) and eat your dinner!

hint.de: Hör auf mit dem, was du tust.

explain.sl:
**stop + -ing: nehaš nekaj delati**
- **Stop talking!** · Nehaj govoriti!
- **We stopped to talk.** · Ustavili smo se, da bi se pogovorili.
explain.de:
**stop + -ing: mit etwas aufhören**
- **Stop talking!** · Hör auf zu reden!
- **We stopped to talk.** · Wir haben angehalten, um zu reden.
explain.it:
**stop + -ing: smettere di fare qualcosa**
- **Stop talking!** · Smettila di parlare!
- **We stopped to talk.** · Ci siamo fermati per parlare.
explain.en:
**stop + -ing: you no longer do it**
- **Stop talking!**
- **We stopped to talk.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Na poti domov smo se ustavili, da bi pogledali jezero.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Auf dem Heimweg haben wir angehalten, um uns den See anzuschauen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Tornando a casa ci siamo fermati a guardare il lago.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: On the way home we stopped to look at the lake.

exercises.text: On the way home we stopped ___ (look) at the lake.

explain.sl:
**stop + to: ustaviš se, da nekaj narediš**
- **We stopped to look at the lake.** · Ustavili smo se, da bi pogledali jezero.
explain.de:
**stop + to: du hältst an, um etwas zu tun**
- **We stopped to look at the lake.** · Wir haben angehalten, um uns den See anzuschauen.
explain.it:
**stop + to: ti fermi per fare qualcosa**
- **We stopped to look at the lake.** · Ci siamo fermati a guardare il lago.
explain.en:
**stop + to: you stop in order to do it**
- **We stopped to look at the lake.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Poppy nekoč ni marala ovsene kaše, zdaj pa jo je vsako jutro.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Früher mochte Poppy keinen Haferbrei, jetzt isst sie ihn jeden Morgen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Una volta a Poppy non piaceva il porridge, ora lo mangia ogni mattina.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Poppy didn't use to like porridge, but now she has it every morning.

exercises.text: Poppy didn't ___ (used to) like porridge, but now she has it every morning.

hint.sl: Za did se glagol vrne v osnovno obliko.
hint.de: Nach did steht das Verb in der Grundform.
hint.it: Dopo did il verbo torna alla forma base.
hint.en: After did, the verb goes back to its base form.

explain.sl:
**Za did: use to (govori se enako; piše se tudi *didn't used to*, pisava hoče use)**
- **She didn't use to like porridge.** · Nekoč ni marala kaše.
explain.de:
**Nach did: use to (klingt gleich; man schreibt auch *didn't used to*, die Schrift will use)**
- **She didn't use to like porridge.** · Früher mochte sie keinen Brei.
explain.it:
**Dopo did: use to (suona uguale; si scrive anche *didn't used to*, lo scritto vuole use)**
- **She didn't use to like porridge.** · Una volta non le piaceva il porridge.
explain.en:
**After did: use to (it sounds the same; people also write *didn't used to*, writing wants use)**
- **She didn't use to like porridge.**

instruction.sl: Fill the gap · Dopolni: Edna me je prosila, naj radio navijem glasneje.
instruction.de: Fill the gap · Ergänze: Edna hat mich gebeten, das Radio lauter zu stellen.
instruction.it: Fill the gap · Completa: Edna mi ha chiesto di alzare il volume della radio.
instruction.en: Fill the gap: Edna asked me to turn the radio up.

exercises.text: Edna asked me ___ (turn) the radio up.

explain.sl:
**ask, tell, want, need + nekdo + to**
- **She asked me to turn it up.** · Prosila me je, naj ga navijem glasneje.
explain.de:
**ask, tell, want, need + jemand + to**
- **She asked me to turn it up.** · Sie hat mich gebeten, es lauter zu stellen.
explain.it:
**ask, tell, want, need + qualcuno + to**
- **She asked me to turn it up.** · Mi ha chiesto di alzare il volume.
explain.en:
**ask, tell, want, need + someone + to**
- **She asked me to turn it up.**

instruction.de: Build the sentence · Bau den Satz
instruction.it: Build the sentence · Costruisci la frase

prompt.en: Where did Edna use to work?

explain.sl:
**Vprašanje: did + use to, za did brez -d**
- **Where did you use to work?** · Kje si včasih {m:delal|f:delala}?
explain.de:
**Die Frage: did + use to, nach did ohne -d**
- **Where did you use to work?** · Wo hast du früher gearbeitet?
explain.it:
**La domanda: did + use to, dopo did senza -d**
- **Where did you use to work?** · Dove lavoravi una volta?
explain.en:
**To ask: did + use to, with no -d after did**
- **Where did you use to work?**

prompt.de: Früher habe ich in Leeds gewohnt.
prompt.en: I used to live in Leeds.

accept: I used to live in Leeds.
I used to live in Leeds once.

explain.sl:
**Kar je bilo in ni več: used to + osnovna oblika**
- **I used to live in Leeds.** · Nekoč sem {m:živel|f:živela} v Leedsu.
- **I don't live there any more.** · Zdaj ne živim več tam.
explain.de:
**Was so war und nicht mehr ist: used to + Grundform**
- **I used to live in Leeds.** · Früher habe ich in Leeds gewohnt.
- **I don't live there any more.** · Jetzt wohne ich nicht mehr dort.
explain.it:
**Ciò che era così e non è più: used to + forma base**
- **I used to live in Leeds.** · Una volta abitavo a Leeds.
- **I don't live there any more.** · Ora non ci abito più.
explain.en:
**What was so and isn't now: used to + the base form**
- **I used to live in Leeds.**
- **I don't live there any more.**

accept: I have decided to learn to knit.
I've decided to learn how to knit.
I have decided to learn how to knit.
I decided to learn to knit.
I decided to learn how to knit.
I have decided to learn knitting.

explain.sl:
**decide in learn + to**
- **I've decided to learn to knit.** · {m:Odločil|f:Odločila} sem se, da se naučim plesti.
explain.de:
**decide und learn + to**

explain.it:
**decide e learn + to**
- **I've decided to learn to knit.** · Ho deciso di imparare a lavorare a maglia.
explain.en:
**decide and learn + to**
- **I've decided to learn to knit.**
